# truenas_system_dataset (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS system dataset configuration (the dataset that holds core system state such as logs, reporting, syslog, and samba4 data). This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one system dataset configuration per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls systemdataset.update (a long-running job that may migrate the system dataset between pools), and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place). WARNING: changing pool moves the system dataset to a different pool, which is a disruptive, long-running operation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_system_dataset" "config" {
  pool = "tank"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `pool` (String) Name of the pool the system dataset lives on. WARNING: changing this migrates the system dataset to the new pool, a disruptive, long-running operation.
- `pool_exclude` (String) Name of a pool to exclude from automatic selection when migrating the system dataset. Write-only: never read back from TrueNAS, and only sent to systemdataset.update when explicitly set.

### Read-Only

- `basename` (String) Base path of the system dataset (e.g. "tank/.system"). Changes whenever pool changes; server-computed, never sent to systemdataset.update.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "system_dataset".
- `path` (String) Filesystem path the system dataset is mounted at (e.g. "/var/db/system"). Server-computed, never sent to systemdataset.update.
- `pool_set` (Boolean) Whether the system dataset pool has been explicitly set. Server-computed, never sent to systemdataset.update.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the system dataset. Server-computed, never sent to systemdataset.update.
